name: Aspect of the Narwhal

effects.name: Aspect of the Narwhal
effects.desc: Resist cold while submerged. Speed = 5 feet, swim speed = 50 feet.

automation.text: A willing creature that you touch takes on the aspects of a narwhal. It grows flippers and a long horn-like tusk. The target gains Resistance to Cold damage while submerged in water, its Speed becomes 5 feet, and it gains a Swim Speed of 50 feet. The target can take a Bonus Action on any turn in which it moves at least 15 feet directly toward an enemy to make a gore attack that deals Piercing damage equal to 2d6 plus its Strength modifier.

subclasses: Occultist Monster Hunter, Sanguine Thief Rogue, Spellslinger Gunslinger, Arcane Hand Monk, Arcane Hand Monk
